verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at exa.ai/llms.txt. The docs also publish /docs/llms.txt and llms-full.txt, plus markdown (.md) versions of reference pages that point agents to the documentation index. Agent skills documentation exists to teach coding agents how to build with Exa's APIs. missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these docs successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://exa.ai/llms.txt # Exa
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://exa.ai/docs/llms.txt
Tool-using agents can call Exa without writing code through the hosted MCP server at https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp
Exa skills teach coding agents how to search, retrieve content, and build with Exa's APIs.
